shortBulletSummary: Crypto Markets See Downturn: Bitcoin dropped to around $63,000, with altcoins also falling as the crypto market shed an estimated $80 billion in value.
FOMC Decision Fuels Caution: The upcoming US Federal Reserve's policy decision is generating market uncertainty, leading to a risk-off sentiment among investors.
Institutional Outflows Pressure BTC: BlackRock's IBIT and other Bitcoin ETFs experienced significant net outflows, contributing to selling pressure on Bitcoin.
Crypto Sentiment Remains Cautious: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index indicates a prevailing "Neutral" to "Fear" sentiment across the market.
